name: ModelVariant157_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant157_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a textured streak flies in an arc from a joint of the active model to the other slot, trailed by ten fading copies, and a 3x3 grid of burst quads plays where it lands); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the 256-point flight path, packs seven texture words and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 or 1 once per strike as the burst starts, 5 to restart a repeat and 2 after the last; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-174 and 304 images build the same source with VERSION_FRENCH, without the work-size printf, and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
